title: Improve and diversify circuit details
body:
- Optimize the number of steps in a cycle down to 6, and define this as "SD6"
- Define "PC3" layout using a 3 step cycle via XCX and similar gates, as well as not doing resets
- Define "EM3" layout using parity measurements
- Add continuous integration
- Split experiment.py into data collection and data plotting
- Add hacked-together 3d text diagrams for testing structure of inner loops
- Add a workaround for pycharm/pybind11/pytest repr bug
- Reorder qubits so measurement qubits are indexed after data qubits
- Use stim 1.5 features like noisy pauli product measurement
- Extract noise modelling into a separate file that can add noise to a stim circuit
